nodes.description: Without synaptojanin-1 Sac1-domain dephosphorylation of PI4P, the clathrin coat and other endocytic factors are not shed, and synaptic-vesicle endocytosis and recycling into the releasable pool are impaired at the nerve terminal; the R258Q knock-in mouse shows an accumulation of clathrin-coated intermediates establishing the Sac domain's role in clathrin-coat dynamics. This is the presynaptic, endocytic mechanism SYNJ1 shares with DNAJC6 (PARK19), whose auxilin product is itself recycled through the Sac1 pathway, as distinct from the mitochondrial-quality-control mechanism of PRKN and PINK1.

nodes.description: The root lesion is a biallelic Sac1-domain defect of synaptojanin-1, a presynaptic phosphoinositide phosphatase. The recurrent PARK20 allele (p.Arg258Gln) lies in the N-terminal Sac1 domain and selectively abolishes its PI4P/PI3P phosphatase activity while leaving the central 5-phosphatase (PI(4,5)P2) activity intact — a partial loss of function. Complete loss of synaptojanin-1 causes a distinct, lethal developmental and epileptic encephalopathy, so the node binds the Sac1 activity specifically rather than total enzyme loss.
